| Parameter | Default | Values | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Output** `output` | Edges (largest moment M) | Edges (largest moment M), Corners (smallest moment m), Feature type | The largest moment of the phase congruency over the directions marks edges, the smallest marks corners. The feature type tells bright lines, steps and dark lines apart. It shows only where the edge value M is at least 0.05, which is our choice. |
| **Scales** `scales` | 4 | 2 to 6 | The number of filter scales. Kovesi suggests 3 to 6. |
| **Directions** `orientations` | 6 | 3 to 12 | The number of filter directions over half a turn. |
| **Smallest wavelength** `minWavelength` | 3 | 2 to 20 px | The wavelength of the finest filter. |
| **Scale factor** `mult` | 2.1 | 1.3 to 4 | Each filter has this many times the wavelength of the one before. |
| **Bandwidth ratio** `sigmaOnf` | 0.55 | 0.3 to 0.9 | The ratio sigma / f_0 of the log-Gabor filters. 0.55 gives about 2 octaves, 0.75 about 1 octave. |
| **Noise factor k** `k` | 2 | 0 to 20 | The noise threshold is the estimated mean of the noise energy plus k standard deviations. |
| **Spread cutoff** `cutoff` | 0.5 | 0 to 1 | The spread of the frequencies below which phase congruency is lowered. |
| **Spread sharpness** `g` | 10 | 1 to 50 | How sharply the weight for the spread of the frequencies changes at the cutoff. |
| **Stretch** `stretch` | on | On or off | Stretch the edges or corners so the largest value is white. With it off, values from 0 to 1 show from black to white. A result below 0.001 everywhere is not stretched. |
| **Border mode** `border` | Reflect | Reflect 101 (default), Reflect, Replicate, Constant (zero), Wrap | How pixels outside the image are filled when the window reaches past the edge. |
